notes: HTTP status is 200 for nearly everything; read the top-level status_code and each tasks[].status_code.
description is the official text; class, retry and agent_action are agent policy derived from it.
retry values: never (fix or stop), once (one resubmit), backoff (wait and slow down), later (retry after minutes), poll (task still running), n/a (not an error).
Never retry spend errors 40200, 40203, 40210; a retry of a live call is billed again.
40204 (subscription required) is no longer in the official table; Backlinks and LLM Mentions are pay as you go since 2026-07-01.
GET /v3/appendix/errors returns this list from the API for free.

codes.description: You are not authorized to access this resource. See your login details here: https://app.dataforseo.com/api-access
codes.agent_action: Check DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD (API Access tab, not the account password).

codes.description: We had a problem billing your account. Please, check your account’s balance.
codes.agent_action: Stop. Tell the user to check the balance; do not retry.

codes.description: Requested endpoint not found
codes.agent_action: Wrong endpoint path; look it up in the catalog.

codes.description: Sorry, we could not process your request due to the internal server error. Please, try again later.
codes.agent_action: Retry later with backoff.

codes.description: the request has been successfully completed
codes.agent_action: Success. Read the result and report the cost field.

codes.description: as a result of the successful request, the task has been created
codes.agent_action: Task queued. Poll tasks_ready, then fetch with task_get.

codes.message: you can set only one task at a time.
codes.description: you cannot specify more than one task in the POST array
codes.agent_action: Live endpoints take one task per call; split the array.

codes.message: this id is used by another client, check the id.
codes.description: the task identifier id is unique to the client used to send the request
codes.agent_action: Use the task id returned to this account.

codes.message: this id is used by another search engine, check the path.
codes.description: the task identifier id is unique to the search engine used in the URL path of the request
codes.agent_action: Fetch the id from the same search engine path it was posted to.

codes.message: this id is used by another search type, check the path.
codes.description: the task identifier id is unique to the search type used in the URL path of the request
codes.agent_action: Fetch the id from the same search type path it was posted to.

codes.message: this id is used by another function, check the id.
codes.description: the task identifier id is unique to the function used in the URL path of the request
codes.agent_action: Fetch the id from the same function path it was posted to.

codes.message: you can set no more than 100 tasks at a time.
codes.description: each POST request can contain up to 100 tasks
codes.agent_action: Send at most 100 tasks per POST; split the batch.

codes.message: Notice containing recommendations for optimizing your API requests.
codes.description: notice can contain different personalized recommendations for optimizing your API requests based on your usage
codes.agent_action: Informational: read the optimization advice and pass it to the user.

codes.message: you are not authorized to access this resource. see your login details here: https://app.dataforseo.com/api-dashboard .
codes.description: check if the specified credentials match those in your account dashboard (https://app.dataforseo.com/api-dashboard)
codes.agent_action: Credentials rejected; check login and API password.

codes.description: the requested search engine was unable to process your request and responded with an error; learn more on our help center (https://dataforseo.com/help-center/what-does-the-40101-error-mean)
codes.agent_action: Search engine error; resubmit once, then report.

codes.description: no results matching the details of your request have been found; learn more on our help center (https://dataforseo.com/help-center/what-does-the-40102-error-mean)
codes.agent_action: No results for this query; report it as an empty result, not a failure. It can still be billed (live test 2026-11-06: ads_search and dataset_info charged), so do not resubmit the same input.

codes.message: task execution failed, please try to resubmit the task.
codes.description: the task could not be executed, try posting another task with similar parameters
codes.agent_action: Resubmit the task once.

codes.message: please verify your account before using the api. you can complete the verification in the user panel: https://app.dataforseo.com/ .
codes.description: email and/or phone verification is required for new users; to use DataForSEO APIs, you have to complete the account verification process in the User Panel (https://app.dataforseo.com/)
codes.agent_action: Account needs email or phone verification in the dashboard; tell the user.

codes.message: The task was deleted and is no longer available.
codes.description: the task that you are referring to has been deleted from our system
codes.agent_action: Task deleted; post a new task if still needed (costs money: re-estimate and ask).

codes.message: Task completed with partial results. Some pages could not be retrieved after several retry attempts. You have not been charged for the pages that were not returned.
codes.description: the task has been completed successfully, but we could not parse some of the requested results; for example, if you set a task to retrieve 100 SERP results, but we only parsed 80 results, you will get 80 results with this error, without being charged for the remaining 20 unparsed results
codes.agent_action: Partial results; unretrieved pages were not charged. Report what is missing.

codes.description: the request cannot be completed until the balance is recharged; check your balance in the account dashboard (https://app.dataforseo.com/api-dashboard)
codes.agent_action: Stop. Balance must be recharged; tell the user. Never retry.

codes.message: we noticed some unusual activity in your dataforseo account, so we’ve temporarily paused access as a precaution. please, reach out to our support team at support@dataforseo.com for more details, and we’ll work with you to resolve this quickly.
codes.description: unusual activity detected in your account may result from the creation of several trial accounts or violation of the DataForSEO Terms of Service in some other way; therefore, your account access and DataForSEO API access have been temporarily paused; contact our support team to resolve the issue
codes.agent_action: Account paused for unusual activity; tell the user to contact DataForSEO support.

codes.message: the rate-limit per minute has been exceeded.
codes.description: you can make up to 10000 requests per minute; contact our support team if you need to increase the limit
codes.agent_action: Per-minute rate limit hit; wait about a minute and slow down.

codes.message: the cost limit has been exceeded. you can modify your cost limit in the user panel https://app.dataforseo.com/api-settings.
codes.description: you can modify daily cost limits for APIs and endpoints in your account dashboard
codes.agent_action: Daily cost limit reached (set in api-settings); stop and tell the user. Never retry.

codes.message: the duplicate task limit per hour has been exceeded. you can modify your limits in the user panel https://app.dataforseo.com/api-settings.
codes.description: you can modify the duplicate task limit in your account dashboard. Learn more. (https://dataforseo.com/help-center/limit-duplicate-tasks)
codes.agent_action: Hourly duplicate-task limit reached; reuse earlier results instead of reposting.

codes.message: the duplicate task limit per day has been exceeded. you can modify your limits in the user panel https://app.dataforseo.com/api-settings .
codes.description: you can modify the duplicate task limit in your account dashboard. Learn more. (https://dataforseo.com/help-center/limit-duplicate-tasks)
codes.agent_action: Daily duplicate-task limit reached; reuse earlier results instead of reposting.

codes.message: access denied. your ip is not whitelisted. you can modify your ip whitelist in the user panel https://app.dataforseo.com/api-access .
codes.description: you can whitelist all the necessary IPs in the account dashboard. Learn more. (https://dataforseo.com/help-center/whitelist-ips)
codes.agent_action: IP not whitelisted; the user must add it in the API Access settings.

codes.description: the limit for simultaneous requests made by a single user is 30
codes.agent_action: Over 30 simultaneous requests; lower concurrency and retry.

codes.message: insufficient funds. your account's balance is too low to complete this request.
codes.description: visit your account dashboard (https://app.dataforseo.com/signin) to add funds; learn more about making payments (https://dataforseo.com/help-center/making-a-payment-changing-details-refunds)
codes.agent_action: Insufficient funds; stop and tell the user. Never retry.

codes.description: the requested resource doesn’t exist; check the URL of the request
codes.agent_action: Resource does not exist; check the URL against the catalog.

codes.description: the requested task does not exist
codes.agent_action: Task id not found; check the id.

codes.description: the URL path of your request is invalid
codes.agent_action: Invalid path; check it against the catalog.

codes.description: it’s not possible to retrieve the results of a task that was created more than a month ago
codes.agent_action: Results older than about a month expired; a new task is needed (re-estimate and ask).

codes.message: no prepared data found.please contact our support team.
codes.description: the Sandbox does not contain prepared data for the task you set
codes.agent_action: Sandbox has no prepared data for this request; change the request or skip the sandbox check.

codes.message: textual content on the target page is insufficient.
codes.description: target page does not have enough textual data, please try specifying a different page
codes.agent_action: Target page has too little text; pick another page.

codes.message: requested page was not submitted for crawling.
codes.description: the page was not submitted for crawling in Task POST
codes.agent_action: Page was not part of the crawl; check the OnPage task.

codes.description: duplicate hosts detected in request
codes.agent_action: Duplicate hosts in the request; deduplicate targets.

codes.description: website resource at the target URL returned a 404 status code or is invalid
codes.agent_action: Target URL invalid or returns 404; check the URL.

codes.description: one of the fields in the POST request is invalid
codes.agent_action: Invalid field value; check parameters against the docs page.

codes.description: the body of your POST request is empty, please check the body structure and validity
codes.agent_action: POST body empty; send a JSON array of task objects.

codes.description: the structure of the POST request is invalid
codes.agent_action: POST body malformed; it must be a JSON array of task objects.

codes.message: the number of intersecting keywords for the specified domains exceeds 10 million. try specifying different domains.
codes.description: there are too many intersecting keywords for the specified domains, please try again with different domain names
codes.agent_action: Too many intersecting keywords (over 10 million); use other domains.

codes.description: location parameters you are using are outdated, please check our documentation or call the relevant locations endpoint for up-tp-date parameters
codes.agent_action: Outdated location parameters; refresh from the locations endpoint.

codes.description: the body of your POST request contains unknown fields, please consult the documentation of the requested endpoint and use available fields
codes.agent_action: Unknown fields in the body; remove them (see the docs page).

codes.description: the task has been received but has not yet been enqueued for processing
codes.agent_action: Task received, not yet queued; poll tasks_ready later.

codes.description: the task has been enqueued for processing
codes.agent_action: Task in queue; poll tasks_ready later.

codes.description: our system encountered an unexpected condition; please contact our support team
codes.agent_action: Internal error; retry later, then report.

codes.description: our system failed to check your account balance; please contact our support team
codes.agent_action: Balance check failed; retry later, then report.

codes.description: you specified a non-existing task or parameter, please check the body of your POST request
codes.agent_action: Non-existent task or parameter; check the body.

codes.description: one of our external data sources is currently unavailable or responded with an error; the error can be triggered by Google Ads API or other third-party services used by DataForSEO API; message of the error may vary depending on the third-party service status; corresponding message examples: Too many requests Could not connect to host 3rd Party API Service Unavailable
codes.agent_action: Third-party source (for example Google Ads) unavailable; retry later.

codes.message: update is in progress. please try after a few minutes
codes.description: the API you’re requesting is being updated; this can take a few minutes
codes.agent_action: API is updating; retry after a few minutes.

codes.message: this function is temporarily unavailable. please contact support for more information.
codes.description: the function you’re requesting failed to respond; please contact our support team for more information
codes.agent_action: Function temporarily unavailable; report and suggest another endpoint.

codes.description: our system failed to process a live-mode task in 120 seconds; please try setting a task one more time
codes.agent_action: Live task timed out after 120 seconds; retry once (a retry is billed again: tell the user).

codes.message: target page took too long to respond.
codes.description: target page took longer than 50 seconds to respond, please try again later or specify a different page
codes.agent_action: Target page took over 50 seconds; retry later or use another page.
